values.label: PUE, IT liquid cooling with waterside economizer and water-cooled chiller (towers), large-scale
values.source_title: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (LBNL-2001637), Figure 4.4
values.quote: Utilization of economizers, adiabatic cooling, or dry coolers can contribute to lower PUE values
values.note: Large-scale class, row 'IT Liquid cooling: waterside economizer (water-cooled chiller)'. Read off the box plot of Figure 4.4 (box = middle half of LBNL's simulated sites, value = median) to about 0.01; the figure was read from its reproduction in Alston et al., arXiv 2609.25437, Figure 2, because the LBNL PDF serves the chart as an image.

values.label: WUE, IT liquid cooling with waterside economizer and water-cooled chiller (towers), large-scale
values.source_title: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (LBNL-2001637), Figure 4.4
values.quote: Data centers employing water-cooled chiller systems without economizers exhibit the highest WUE
values.note: Large-scale class, same row; the water is evaporated in the cooling towers. Read off the box plot of Figure 4.4 (box = middle half of LBNL's simulated sites, value = median) to about 0.01; the figure was read from its reproduction in Alston et al., arXiv 2609.25437, Figure 2, because the LBNL PDF serves the chart as an image.

values.label: PUE, IT liquid cooling with dry coolers (air-cooled chiller), large-scale
values.source_title: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (LBNL-2001637), Figure 4.4
values.quote: Utilization of economizers, adiabatic cooling, or dry coolers can contribute to lower PUE values
values.note: Large-scale class, row 'IT Liquid cooling: dry cooler (air-cooled chiller)'. Warm-water liquid cooling (ASHRAE class W45 in LBNL's model) lets dry coolers reject heat without chillers most of the year. Read off the box plot of Figure 4.4 (box = middle half of LBNL's simulated sites, value = median) to about 0.01; the figure was read from its reproduction in Alston et al., arXiv 2609.25437, Figure 2, because the LBNL PDF serves the chart as an image.

values.label: WUE, IT liquid cooling with dry coolers (air-cooled chiller), large-scale
values.source_title: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (LBNL-2001637), Figure 4.4
values.quote: While air-cooled chillers use no water, they use more energy.
values.note: Large-scale class, same row: the figure shows zero; a closed loop with dry coolers evaporates no water. Read off the box plot of Figure 4.4 (box = middle half of LBNL's simulated sites, value = median) to about 0.01; the figure was read from its reproduction in Alston et al., arXiv 2609.25437, Figure 2, because the LBNL PDF serves the chart as an image.

values.label: PUE, air-cooled IT with air-cooled chillers and dry-cooler free cooling
values.source_title: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (LBNL-2001637), Figure 4.4
values.quote: While air-cooled chillers use no water, they use more energy.
values.note: Midsize class, row 'Dry cooler (air-cooled chiller)': LBNL models large-scale air-cooled halls only with adiabatic or economizer assists, so the midsize row is the closest match for an air hall on air-cooled chillers. Plain air-cooled chillers without free cooling sit higher (median about 1.84). Read off the box plot of Figure 4.4 (box = middle half of LBNL's simulated sites, value = median) to about 0.01; the figure was read from its reproduction in Alston et al., arXiv 2609.25437, Figure 2, because the LBNL PDF serves the chart as an image.

values.label: WUE, air-cooled IT with air-cooled chillers and dry-cooler free cooling
values.source_title: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (LBNL-2001637), Figure 4.4
values.quote: While air-cooled chillers use no water, they use more energy.
values.note: Midsize class, same row: the figure shows a point just above zero (about 0.05). Read off the box plot of Figure 4.4 (box = middle half of LBNL's simulated sites, value = median) to about 0.01; the figure was read from its reproduction in Alston et al., arXiv 2609.25437, Figure 2, because the LBNL PDF serves the chart as an image.

values.label: Construction cost, most advanced AI-specific facilities, US
